content.title: THE {{NUTRIENT}} GAPS MOST DIETS DON'T COVER
facts: **Pumpkin** has nearly double the potassium of a banana, gram for gram, and most people don't even think to compare the two.
**Swiss chard** delivers more vitamin K in one cooked cup than a whole steak has protein per serving in terms of daily value coverage.
**Dried apricots** pack more iron per 100g than the same amount of red meat, but without the saturated fat.
**Brazil nuts** are so loaded with selenium that just 1-2 nuts a day covers your entire daily requirement.
**Mushrooms** left in sunlight for 10-15 minutes before cooking can spike their vitamin D content dramatically — most people toss them straight in the pan without knowing this.
**Chickpeas** carry more fiber per cup than a bowl of oatmeal, making them a sneaky gut-health upgrade.
**Sardines** contain more calcium per serving than a glass of milk, edible bones included.
**Hemp seeds** are one of the few plant foods with a meaningful dose of omega-3 ALA, close to 2 tablespoons/day covering a solid chunk of your needs.
**Oysters** have more zinc per serving than any other food on the planet, several times more than red meat.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
